newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec says new term bonds on sale year-round.
newsitem.headline: Quebec says new term bonds on sale year-round.

text.p: Quebec said on Wednesday that its new Quebec Term Bonds (QTBs) were available for sale year round.

The bonds are guaranteed by the Quebec government whatever the amount invested. Two types of QTBs will offered: 10-year step-up QTBs, redeemable each year on the purchase anniversary date; and fixed rate QTBs offering a range of maturities from one to 10 years.

The interest rates applying to the two products will range from 3.25 percent to 10 percent, depending on maturity and the type of product. For example, the average compound rate of the step-up bond held for 10 years is 6.68 percent, while the rate for a fixed-term bond for the same period is 6.8 percent.
The rates are guaranteed until maturity. The bonds will be available from Placements Quebec, financial institutions and investment dealers.
